children: On Saturday, economist and longtime Bitcoin critic
Peter Schiff
said
Bitcoin
’s
slide is gaining momentum.
In a post on X, Schiff said selling could accelerate if the price breaks $50,000. He added that it could then quickly fall to the 2022 low, below $16,500.
Schiff said he would not be surprised by a retest of that level before year-end. If that happens, he wrote, it is "curtains" for
Strategy Inc.

The Bitcoin collapse is gathering steam. I expect the momentum to pick up once Bitcoin breaks $50K. In fact, once it does, it could be a quick trip to the 2022 low below $16.5K. I wouldn't be surprised to see a retest of that level before year-end. If so, it's curtains for
Bitcoin Already Trades Below Strategy’s Cost Basis
As of Nov. 1, Strategy’s
was $75,451 per Bitcoin. According to Coinbase data, Bitcoin is priced at $67,113.93, down about 2% on the day. That sits $8,337.07, or about 11%, below the company’s cost basis.
Schiff’s targets imply steeper losses. A move to $50,000 would be about 25.5% below current levels. A drop to $16,500 would be about 75.4% lower.
In a separate interview Thursday with Bitcoin Magazine, Schiff said Bitcoin has

params.linkText: never posted two straight down years

children: , a pattern he says is about to break. He predicted the price would head "well below 10,000," a decline of about 85.1% from current levels. Schiff said most Bitcoin now sits with ETFs and treasury companies like Strategy, which he sees as vulnerable to fast selling.
Bullish $100K Calls Face a Test as Bitcoin Slips
Other market voices have been far more optimistic. In late October, investor
Mike Alfred
said on the All Things Markets podcast that he would

params.linkText: bet up to $1 million that Bitcoin

children: reaches $100,000 before $60,000. Host
Anthony Scaramucci
, founder of
SkyBridge Capital
, said he agrees.
Alfred said he does not expect Bitcoin to fall below $57,000 to $58,000 again. Of Schiff, Alfred said he "should have just bought it instead."
Bitcoin has since slid about 17% from the $80,840 it traded at when Alfred spoke. His $60,000 line now sits about 10.6% below current levels, while his $100,000 target is about 49% above them.
Why MSTR Is the Pressure Point
Strategy’s exposure explains why Schiff targets the stock. Its latest purchase added 811 BTC for about $65.5 million, lifting total holdings to 849,327 BTC.
Over the past 52 weeks, Strategy’s stock has traded as high as $213.83 and as low as $81.81.

title: Peter Schiff Warns Bitcoin May Fall Below $16,500 After $50,000 Break, Says It Could Be 'Curtains' for Strategy
